environment.description: Linux; frozen CW-10 candidate; actual OMP 18.2.10 manager and worker TUI peers; real Git detached worktree and persistent host shell

items.evidence: Actual OMP 18.2.10 manager/worker TUI peers processed an approved Task. The exact public worker execute response preceded delivery_omp_processed, the persistent host shell recorded sent/accepted/started/ended, exit status 0 was confirmed, and durable raw-log/result locations plus hashes were recorded. Cleanup left no OMP child, provider thread, cwd process, or socket residue.

Actual worker OMP produced separately bound execute and analysis responses with distinct response IDs and exact Task/revision/run/message/attempt/session/generation identities; analysis sequence 10 preceded processed sequence 12 and the worker reported success from exit/log/result evidence. Independent live host cases also exercised nonzero failure, exit-zero criterion failure, and missing-log indeterminate; the 33-test workflow runtime covers no automatic return after a modification-needed report and pause/authority holds.
